fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Dade County grand jury practices and the acquittal of Senator Hayes Lewis, criticizing State's Attorney Vernon Hawthorne and the use of entrapment in gambling investigations. Contains extensive local nightlife and entertainment listings and advertisements (clubs, bars, shows), sports and racing coverage including Hialeah Park notes and tipster columns, and a Better Housing Program feature outlining financing under the National Housing Act.
